detail.title: CP-UNP-F4541L30-DPQ

features: Instastream, H.265, H.264, H.264H, H.264B, MJPEG
WDR(120dB), 2D NR/ 3D NR, Day/Night(ICR), ROI, Defog, AWB, BLC, HLC
Up to 300 Presets, 5 Scan, 8 Tour, 5 Pattern
